topic: Foundation settling into lines after 50 (prep + Sheer Glow BB + Set & Stay)
text:
Foundation settling into your lines after 50? It's usually the prep, not your face.

1. Let skincare absorb first: Booster, Serum, Booster, Cream, dry between
2. Sunscreen
3. A thin BB, blended with fingertips
4. 1-2 sprays of setting spray

Save this for tomorrow morning.
picture_tip: Flat lay on your vanity in window light: Dermatology Booster, Serum, Cream, Moisture Layer Sunscreen, Sheer Glow BB, Set & Stay spray in a row, numbered 1-6 with sticky notes.
video_tip: 12-15s vertical clip: spray Booster and wait (on-screen 'wait'), massage Serum, spray Booster again, Cream with spatula, sunscreen, dot BB and blend, two spritzes of spray. Text overlay: 'Prep is the secret after 50'.

topic: Winter cracked lips: Glow Up Lip Oil as an overnight lip mask
text:
Your lips aren't failing. Winter air is.

My furnace-season fix: a generous layer of lip oil at bedtime, left on overnight like a sleeping mask.

Mine is RIMAN Glow Up Lip Oil (a light cool tingle is normal, it has menthol).

Where does winter hit you first?
picture_tip: Close-up of the Glow Up Lip Oil on your nightstand beside a book and reading glasses, warm lamp light.
video_tip: 8-10s clip: bedside lamp on, swipe a generous layer of lip oil, cap it, lights off. Text: 'Night shift for winter lips'.

topic: Straw-like hair ends in furnace season (botalab Deserticola shampoo, conditioner, hair oil)
text:
If your hair ends feel like straw once the heat comes on, try this:

1. Shampoo on the scalp only, warm water
2. Conditioner after
3. 1-2 pumps of hair oil on mid-lengths and ends, never the roots

I use botalab Deserticola for all three. Save this for wash day.
picture_tip: The three botalab Deserticola bottles (shampoo, conditioner, hair oil serum) on the shower ledge or bathroom counter, labels out, bright daylight.
video_tip: 10-12s clip: 1-2 pumps of oil into your palm, rub hands, smooth through ends only, then a slow-motion hair flip. Text: 'Ends only. Never the roots.'

topic: Fewer products for sensitive skin (RIMAN calming gel)
text:
When my skin gets red and touchy, I don't add more. I take things away.

Cleanser. Calming gel. Moisturizer. That's it until it settles.

Sensitive skin over 70 wants less fuss, not more steps.

What's the one product you'd never give up?
